name: ctip-biodiversitysystem
description: Daun Sense — Smart Ground-Truthing & Digital Biodiversity System

scripts.instructions:
node -e "console.log('
=== DAUN SENSE WORKSPACE INSTRUCTIONS ===

Version:
  npm run app-version         Show the version: 1.0.<commit count>, raised by every commit.
                              Change MAJOR.MINOR in package.json "version" for a new release line.

Mobile App (Expo):
  npm run mobile              Start mobile app on local network (same Wi-Fi)
  npm run mobile:tunnel       Start mobile app with tunnel (connect across different networks/cellular)
  npm run mobile:android      Start mobile app on connected Android device/emulator
  npm run mobile:web          Start mobile app in web browser mode
  npm run mobile:build:apk    Build the Android APK on EAS (stamps the app version first)
  npm run mobile:test:agent   Run automated Android emulator + local AI agent test suite
  npm run mobile:test:agent:ui Launch interactive Web Test Studio dashboard
  npm run mobile:test:agent:watch Run mobile agent tests in live watch mode

Web Portal (React + Vite):
  npm run web                 Start web dev server at http://localhost:5173
  npm run web:build           Build web portal for production
  npm run web:lint            Run ESLint code quality checks
  npm run test:agent          Run automated Web + local AI agent test suite
  npm run test:agent:ui       Launch Playwright interactive UI test runner

Backend API (Express):
  npm run api                 Start backend API in development watch mode
  npm run api:start           Start backend API in production mode
  npm run api:test            Run API automated test suite
')"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install && npm --prefix services/api install
